verdict.comment: Preference is for the major Cheltenham achievements of EAST INDIA DOCK over the high promise of Lulamba.

comments.bluelemons: Useful on Flat and asserted in clearcut style on hurdle debut at Gowran Park (2m, soft)
comments.charlus: Useful on Flat; scored at Naas on hurdling debut but form leaves him with plenty to find
comments.eastindiadock: 3-3 hurdling, with wide-margin wins in Grade 2 races here on last two; sets good standard
comments.gibbsisland: Fairly useful on Flat; scored at Sedgefield and Haydock (impressive) over hurdles
comments.helloneighbour: Unbeaten on Flat and in two Graded races as hurdler; travelled much the best in Gr1 latest
comments.ladyvegaallen: Seemingly the pick of the Mullins multitude and a greater stamina test here should suit
comments.larzac: Favourite at Auteuil (2m2f, heavy) in October and looked in charge until final strides
comments.lulamba: Won at Auteuil; major reputation preceded his highly promising win at Ascot on yard debut
comments.lumieredularge: Won a French bumper in October; second of eight in maiden hurdle at Pau in December
comments.marchedaligre: Won easily on hurdle debut; 2nd in Grade 2 at Chepstow but disappointing at Haydock latest
comments.mondoman: Flat class; needs to settle; stronger pace in this should assist, as might the new hood
comments.opec: Won fillies' Listed event at Newbury (2m, soft); major backward steps in Grade 2s since
comments.pappano: Useful form twice at 1m6f in September/October; 200,000gns buy in October; hurdle debut
comments.placedelanation: 2nd to stablemate last time; should improve but that doesn't make her a Triumph principal
comments.poniros: Useful Flat form at up to 1m4f; 200,000gns buy in October; unraced over hurdles
comments.saintelucie: Impressive Irish debut; flopped when favourite for Grade 1 latest and a hood is enlisted
comments.toobossyforus: Useful at 1m6f on Flat; sold for 330,000gns in October and gelded; makes hurdle debut
comments.willydehouelle: Two supporting roles when hooded in Graded races won by Hello Neighbour; ran on last time

races.raceComment: eastindiadock is strongly preferred with a score of 58.8%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form and superior course form over opec. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 5/14 at cheltenham. Key attributes include superior ratings and excellent form and optimal distance and strong course form, though inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: The latest challengers crowd round but GALOPIN DES CHAMPS has stood the test of time so well and he can take home his third Gold Cup.

comments.ahoysenor: Latest win was Grade 2 here in early 2023; Aintree is his safe haven now; has had wind op
comments.banbridge: First 3m chase run when winning King George; has further to go on a much stiffer finish
comments.corbettscross: Won at 3m6f here last March; strong form at Aintree after; return to staying trip helpful
comments.galopindeschamps: Outstanding stayer who has won the last two Gold Cups; big chance of making it three
comments.gentlemansgame: Pulled up in 2024 Gold Cup; form needs improvement; others can cope better with this test
comments.inothewayurthinkin: Big improver when winning the Kim Muir and a Grade 1 last spring; coming to hand; a threat
comments.montysstar: High class as novice; just two runs this term; creditable show latest; open to improvement
comments.royalepagaille: Just respectable form in three previous Gold Cups; down on his luck in latest two starts
comments.therealwhacker: Won 3m novice here in 2023; life harder since; more needed than Grade 2 win in November

races.raceComment: galopindeschamps is marginally preferred with a score of 60.2%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more progressive over banbridge. Won 2 of last 2 starts. Ground (Good To Soft) looks ideal with 12 wins from 15 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 14/20 at cheltenham. Key attributes include strong course form and improving, though inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: If The Organiser isn't over Tuesday's exertions, KING OF YORK could follow up 2024's race win ahead of stablemate Thanks Dad.

comments.billymcgarry: 6lb swing (ignoring claims that day) with King Of York for almost 3l latest (C&D); chance
comments.blufferonthebus: Mark 3lb above last winning one seems conquerable; eyecatching 6f fourth here a year ago
comments.embarked: 10lb below last winning mark (C&D), but needs returning blinkers to provoke a revival
comments.emilypost: Outran her mark despite pace bias against her over C&D latest; turn inching closer again
comments.guyfawkes: Yet to reproduce level of C&D novice debut win of late 2023; behind Soames Forsyte latest
comments.kingofyork: Mowed down Billy McGarry latest (C&D); still 11lb lower than for 2024 win in this race
comments.serenitydream: Player on form of two Tapeta efforts before Christmas, but not so on more recent evidence
comments.soamesforsyte: Would not settle over C&D latest, but race not run to suit; remains of interest
comments.thanksdad: Back on track with a close C&D third in first-time visor latest; enters calculations
comments.theorganiser: C&D 0-72 scorer on Tuesday night's stable/Tapeta debut; player if over those exertions
comments.woodleigh: Best Tapeta RPR is 16lb shy of the turf equivalent; refused to settle again latest (C&D)

races.raceComment: soamesforsyte is marginally preferred with a score of 58.2%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over billymcgarry. Won 2 of last 6 starts. comments.cashorcrypto: Has ability but he's refused to race in four of last eight starts; risky on stable debut
comments.dolcecourage: C&D win on debut but all runs since at 1m; something to prove after 12 weeks off
comments.invincibleaura: Good record on AW but he will need a good pace to aim at back at 7f
comments.legalreform: Two wins and a second in three C&D runs this year; career-high mark but still respected
comments.tropezpower: C&D win off 1lb lower 11 months ago; down in class with J Hart back on board; respected
comments.zip: Newcastle win in Nov is strong form; respectable since; dangerous if left alone up front

verdict.comment: Diamondonthehill should go well but OUR HAVANA (nap) won well over C&D in January and ran well in a hot Class 2 last time.

comments.courtofsession: Not beaten far at Wolverhampton last week; easy lead a possibility but others are stronger
comments.diamondonthehill: Good runs in defeat in three starts this year; should be in the thick of it once again
comments.eligible: Wouldn't judge him harshly on last two runs; dangerous mark if getting a pace to run at
comments.feeltheneed: 1m win here in December; placed on his last two Southwell runs; each-way shout
comments.ourhavana: Taken well to AW, winning easily over C&D in January; fair run in hot race here last time
comments.tencommitments: Won twice for Jamie Osborne last year but in a lower grade; best watched on stable debut
comments.toughenough: Three wins for J Tate; gelded prior to stable debut but has a nine-month absence to defy
comments.waytodubai: 0-13 in Britain for C Fellowes but starts out for new yard off reduced mark; check market

races.raceComment: ourhavana is marginally preferred with a score of 51.8%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over diamondonthehill. Won 2 of last 6 starts. verdict.comment: We Never Stop won't be easy to peg back but BADRI loves it around here, is in top form and can win again.

comments.badri: Two fine runs this year, winning over C&D before a second at Newcastle (5f); big player
comments.coachello: Got up late at Wolverhampton in December; excuses twice since; needs a good pace to run at
comments.fahrenheitseven: Progressive 3yo who is tactically versatile; can do better this year but this is harder
comments.fivethousandtoone: Has high-class AW form; retains all his ability for new yard; drawn wide but e-w shout
comments.havanagreattime: 7f win at Lingfield in December; below par here in cheekpieces last month; others stronger
comments.juanlespins: Well short of his best this winter; tumbled down the weights but others are safer
comments.manyastar: Three 6f wins this year, two of them at this track; looks high in the weights now
comments.mumstipple: Down in the weights but hasn't been shaping as though he was ready to capitalise
comments.rohaan: Handicapped to win & went close over C&D last month; another who could do with a good pace
comments.rosario: No win since debut; close third at Kempton last time but was well positioned
comments.shartash: Found Lingfield too sharp after a break last month; still ran well and this track can help
comments.tigercrusade: 6f win at Wolverhampton in January; fair efforts since; drawn widest but not discounted
comments.weneverstop: Two fine C&D runs in late 2024; bad draw over 5f latest; dangerous if getting an easy lead

races.raceComment: manyastar is marginally preferred with a score of 56.5%, holding clear edges in superior course form over badri. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 4 wins from 15 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: A number of these tend to be held up and this looks good for BRAVO ZULU (nap), who's currently 3-3 for Rossa Ryan.

comments.bravozulu: Currently 5-11 on the AW and 3-5 in headgear; shows a good attitude and is shortlisted
comments.cholaempire: Only been beyond 7f once, when not looking to see it out; this is rather more competitive
comments.edenstorm: Often blows the start; another hold-up performer who'll be reliant on getting the breaks
comments.hitched: Enjoyed a good winter, winning four times and going 20lb up the weights; needs more again
comments.pearleye: Goes well fresh and is ideally suited by easy, left-handed courses; is one to consider
comments.superover: Struggled in three runs for his current trainer-jockey, including here on Wednesday night
comments.tempus: Losing run now stands at 24 but is undeniably well handicapped having been dropped 4lb
comments.urbanroad: Goes up in class tonight as he chases a four-timer off a 6lb higher mark; more needed

races.raceComment: urbanroad is marginally preferred with a score of 69.1%. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws advantaged around tight left-handed polytrack

verdict.comment: On a career-low mark, SECOND COLLECTION has always liked it here and has Molly Gunn taking off 7lb. Stroxx is next best.

comments.admirablelad: Three-time course winner who can miss the break; only holds each-way claims
comments.astapor: Doesn't boast a good record first time out and stall 11 isn't ideal for a front-runnner
comments.hihohtonto: Few costly defeats for Matt Crawley last autumn; has offered little in three runs back
comments.himawari: Regressive maiden; needs to find a bit more, minus the hood tonight, if she's to take this
comments.midnightattheoasis: Regressive gelding who rarely dips below 6f these days; Rossa Ryan is a positive booking
comments.redwalls: Latest effort here from stall 11 best overlooked but another furlong would have been ideal
comments.secondcollection: Won't mind drop from 6f; is adaptable regarding tactics; one to consider despite stall 10
comments.starshot: Longstanding maiden (5f-1m4f) who's done better since returned to sprint trips; player
comments.streetlife: Rarely runs badly over C&D; doesn't arrive in any form but a better showing wouldn't shock
comments.stroxx: In good form and is well drawn for one who's all about speed; has a good bit in his favour
comments.warzone: Been in good form round Chelmsford since his C&D second; should go well once more

races.raceComment: warzone is marginally preferred with a score of 51.4%. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Optician should go well again, but ROGUE TORNADO turned in a career-best effort on his first crack at 1m6f on Tapeta last time.

comments.cardano: Hard to win with now and become inconsistent; nothing to suggest he's best caught fresh
comments.knockbrex: Has only gone this far once and is a strong traveller who has stamina to prove
comments.optician: Always been best round here; is straightforward and reliable, and should go well again
comments.pleasantman: Out of his depth for his new trainer three weeks ago; is high enough in the weights
comments.robusto: Hung right when well below previous levels last time; is ultimately weighted to his best
comments.roguetornado: Hasn't had many runs over this trip, or on Tapeta, and could well be up to it upped 4lb
comments.tradesman: Long odds-on to blow the start and doesn't come without risk, minus headgear tonight

races.raceComment: optician is marginally preferred with a score of 61.3%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over roguetornado. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 5 wins from 15 starts in similar conditions, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
